pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī jìnwū shí , xiān wèn shuí bǎ tā de shuǐ hē le .
pairs.english: Entering the room, Instructor Bai first asked who had drunk her water.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师进屋时，先问谁把她的水喝了。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng liǎngzhī hú , yìzhī gòng rén hē , yìzhī gòng shìyàn yòng . hú shēn míngmíng tiēzhe bùtóng yánsè de zhǐ , pà wò què réng bǎ bēizi wǎng shēnhòu cáng le cáng . tā kànjiàn , jiào tā ná chūlái wén , wén wán zài juédìng yào buyào rènzuì .
pairs.english: Two kettles stood on the table, one for drinking, one for experiments. Despite their different coloured labels, Pavo hid his cup behind him. She told him to bring it out and smell it before deciding whether to confess.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上两只壶，一只供人喝，一只供试验用。壶身明明贴着不同颜色的纸，帕沃却仍把杯子往身后藏了藏。她看见，叫他拿出来闻，闻完再决定要不要认罪。

pairs.target: bēi lǐ shì chá . tā sōng le kǒuqì , wūlǐ de rén yǐjīng xiào qǐlái . bǎi lǎoshī jiāng lìngyìzhī hú tí shàngtái , dǎo chū yìdiǎn wēnshuǐ , shuō zhè shuǐ yě búshì dú , zhǐshì jīntiān bù ná dùzǐ liáng wēndù .
pairs.english: His cup held tea. He relaxed as the room laughed. Instructor Bai lifted the other kettle onto the bench and poured lukewarm water, saying it was not poison either, but stomachs were not today’s thermometers.
pairs.hanzi: 杯里是茶。他松了口气，屋里的人已经笑起来。柏老师将另一只壶提上台，倒出一点温水，说这水也不是毒，只是今天不拿肚子量温度。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài tèlún pángbiān . yuánxiān mō guàn le tiěpiàn de nà zhāng zhuōshàng , rújīn fàng zhe liǎnggēn yánsè bùtóng de duǎn tóngtiáo , gèzì jià zài gérè de xiǎo zuò lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi sat beside Teren. On the table familiar from iron practice lay two short copper rods of different colours, each on a small insulated support.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在特伦旁边。原先摸惯了铁片的那张桌上，如今放着两根颜色不同的短铜条，各自架在隔热的小座里。

pairs.target: lǎoshī shuō tāmen shì liǎngzhǒng pèi hǎo de tónghéjīn , wánzhěng tǐjī xiāngděng , chǐcùn yǔ biǎo shàng de shù dōu hé guò , bùnéng suíbiàn ná biéde tóng lái tì .
pairs.english: The teacher said they were two matched copper alloys of equal whole volume, dimensions checked against the sheet, not replaceable with arbitrary copper.
pairs.hanzi: 老师说它们是两种配好的铜合金，完整体积相等，尺寸与表上的数都核过，不能随便拿别的铜来替。

pairs.target: měi gēn tiáo de yìduān shēnjìn wēnshuǐ cáo , lìngyìduān tiēzhe yì xiǎodài jiào liáng de shuǐ . shuǐdài lǐ gè yǒu yìzhī xì wēn guǎn , yè zhù dī dī dì tíng zhe .
pairs.english: One end of each rod entered a warm-water bath, the other touching a small bag of cooler water. Each bag held a slender thermometer, its liquid column resting low.
pairs.hanzi: 每根条的一端伸进温水槽，另一端贴着一小袋较凉的水。水袋里各有一支细温管，液柱低低地停着。

pairs.target: zhōngduàn lùchū kě jiēchù de xiǎo miàn , lǎoshī xiāncè guò nàlǐ , zhǐshì wēi wēn , rè duān lìngwài dǎng hǎo , búràng shǒuwù pèng .
pairs.english: A small contact patch was exposed in the middle, checked by the teacher as only mildly warm; the hot end was separately guarded against accidental touch.
pairs.hanzi: 中段露出可接触的小面，老师先测过那里，只是微温，热端另外挡好，不让手误碰。

pairs.target: tā méi jí zhe zuò jiè xìng , xiān jiào tāmen kàn liǎngzhī wēn guǎn wǎngshàngzǒu .
pairs.english: She did not rush into exchange, first having them watch both thermometer columns rise.
pairs.hanzi: 她没急着做借性，先叫他们看两支温管往上走。

pairs.target: yìzhī kuài yìdiǎn , yìzhī màn yìdiǎn . tèlún zài zhǐ shàng jì shí , tǎ wéi dīng zhe yè zhù , chàdiǎn lián yǎnjīng yě bù zhǎ .
pairs.english: One rose faster, one slower. Teren recorded the time; Tavi stared at the liquid columns, almost forgetting to blink.
pairs.hanzi: 一支快一点，一支慢一点。特伦在纸上记时，塔维盯着液柱，差点连眼睛也不眨。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī guòlái jiāng zhǐ zhuǎnzhèng , wèn tā yào kàn nǎ yìtiáoxiàn , háishì zhǔnbèi bǎ liǎngtiáo dōu dīng tíng . tā xiào zhe dītóu , bǎ dìyīzǔ shùjì xiàlái .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai straightened his sheet and asked which line he meant to read, or whether he planned to stare both into stopping. He laughed, looked down and recorded the first set of figures.
pairs.hanzi:
柏老师过来将纸转正，问他要看哪一条线，还是准备把两条都盯停。
他笑着低头，把第一组数记下来。

pairs.target: " rè cóng nǎér lái ? " tā wèn . " húlǐ . " pà wò shuō . " shuí shāo de ? " pà wò bù dá le .
pairs.english: “Where does the heat come from?” she asked. “The kettle,” Pavo said. “Who heated it?” Pavo fell silent.
pairs.hanzi:
“热从哪儿来？”她问。
“壶里。”帕沃说。
“谁烧的？”
帕沃不答了。

pairs.target: tā shuō zàofáng de rén shāo de , búshì tā gāngcái zhàn zài ménkǒu dèng chūlái de . wūlǐ yòu xiào , tǎ wéi què kàn xiàng nà yìxiǎo cáo shuǐ , yuánlái zhè táng kè cóng kāishǐ jiù yǐjīng yǒurén zài wàitou zuò le gōng .
pairs.english: She said the kitchen staff heated it, not her glare from the doorway. The room laughed again, but Tavi looked at the little bath: someone outside had been working for this lesson since the start.
pairs.hanzi: 她说灶房的人烧的，不是她刚才站在门口瞪出来的。屋里又笑，塔维却看向那一小槽水，原来这堂课从开始就已经有人在外头做了工。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī bǎ tóngyàng de zhuāngzhì chóngxīn huànhuí qǐchū de shuǐwēn , jiào liǎngbiān gè jì yíbiàn . tā xiān tiēzhù liǎngmiàn , zhī jì shǒu fàngshàngqù ér méiyǒu jiāohuàn shí de dúshù , huànshuǐ fùchá hòu , cái kāishǐ zhēnzhèng de chángshì .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai reset the apparatus to its initial water temperatures and had both sides recorded. She first contacted both patches to measure hand contact without exchange, then changed the water and checked again before the real attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师把同样的装置重新换回起初的水温，叫两边各记一遍。她先贴住两面，只记手放上去而没有交换时的读数，换水复查后，才开始真正的尝试。

pairs.target: zhǔnbèi tuǒdàng , tā jiāng shuāngshǒu fēnbié tiēzhù zhōngduàn lùchū de jiēchùmiàn .
pairs.english: Ready, she placed both hands on the exposed middle contact patches.
pairs.hanzi: 准备妥当，她将双手分别贴住中段露出的接触面。

pairs.target: méiyǒu huǒmiáo . méiyǒu nǎ zhī wēn guǎn hūrán chōng dào dǐngshàng . guò le jǐ xī , yuánběn shēng dé màn de nà zhī kuài le yìdiǎn , lìng yìzhī què bǐ xiānqián màn , zhǐ shàng liǎngdào duǎnxiàn jiànjiàn fēnkāi .
pairs.english: No flame, no thermometer suddenly shooting to the top. After a few breaths, the slower-rising one sped up slightly while the other slowed; two short lines on the paper gradually separated.
pairs.hanzi: 没有火苗。没有哪支温管忽然冲到顶上。过了几息，原本升得慢的那支快了一点，另一支却比先前慢，纸上两道短线渐渐分开。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tāmen bàoshù , tīng wán , xiān zài shuāngshǒu réng tiēzhe shí qǔxiāo , zài sōngkāi . liǎngzhī yè zhù méiyǒu gēnzhe tuìhuí yuánwèi , tǎ wéi zhèngyào wèn , tā yǐjīng jiào rén bié cādiào gāngcái de shù .
pairs.english: The teacher had them call readings, then cancelled while both hands still touched before releasing. The liquid columns did not return to their old positions; as Tavi was about to ask, she told everyone not to erase the figures.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他们报数，听完，先在双手仍贴着时取消，再松开。两支液柱没有跟着退回原位，塔维正要问，她已经叫人别擦掉刚才的数。

pairs.target: " jìn le shuǐdài lǐ de rè , yǐjīng zài lǐmiàn . shōuhuí de shì kuàimàn , búshì bǎ gāngcái nàxiē rè zài zhuā huílái . "
pairs.english: “The heat that entered the water bags is already there. We cancel the change in rate, not grab back the heat that already passed.”
pairs.hanzi: “进了水袋里的热，已经在里面。收回的是快慢，不是把刚才那些热再抓回来。”

pairs.target: tā lìnghuàn huí qǐchū de shuǐ , chóngxīn zuò pǔtōng dúshù , shēngwēn de sùdù cái yòu tóng kāitóu duì dé shàng .
pairs.english: She replaced the water at its initial temperatures and took ordinary readings again; only then did the warming rates match the beginning.
pairs.hanzi: 她另换回起初的水，重新做普通读数，升温的速度才又同开头对得上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ shí zhuó kòu jìn mù jiàn de xiāo tóu . shǒu názǒu , dōngxī hòulái zěnyàng , bìng bùquánshì nà yìdiǎn jiāohuàn hái zài . kě yǎnqián de rè bǐ mùtou gèng kànbújiàn , tā gāng juéde dǒng le , yòu fāxiànzìjǐ lián wèntí gāi fàng nǎ yìbiān dōu méi lǐqīng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the pin head set into wood at Stonewash. What happened after hands left was not all lingering exchange. But heat was less visible than wood; just when he felt he understood, he realized he could not even sort which side his question belonged on.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起石濯扣进木件的销头。手拿走，东西后来怎样，并不全是那一点交换还在。可眼前的热比木头更看不见，他刚觉得懂了，又发现自己连问题该放哪一边都没理清。

pairs.target: tèlún zhǐ gěi tā kàn biǎo shàng de liǎngliè , yíliè shì wēndù , yíliè shì měi yìxiǎo duànshíjiān zǒu le duōshǎo . tā gāngcái jiāng hòumiàn nà yíliè chāo jìn le qiánmiàn .
pairs.english: Teren showed him the sheet’s two columns: temperature, and movement per short interval. He had copied the second into the first.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦指给他看表上的两列，一列是温度，一列是每一小段时间走了多少。他刚才将后面那一列抄进了前面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ěrduo yǒudiǎn rè , nábǐ gǎi . tā běnlái yǐwéi tèlún yàoshuō yíjù , què tīngjiàn duìfāng xiǎoshēng wèn , lǎoshī gāngcái shìbushì yě kànlòu le pà wò de dìèrbēi chá .
pairs.english: Tavi’s ears warmed as he corrected it. Expecting a remark from Teren, he instead heard a quiet question: had the teacher missed Pavo’s second cup of tea too?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维耳朵有点热，拿笔改。他本来以为特伦要说一句，却听见对方小声问，老师刚才是不是也看漏了帕沃的第二杯茶。

pairs.target: tā táitóu , pà wò guǒrán zài dǎo , hú shàng de zhǐ zhèhuí hái tèyì zhuǎn dào wàimiàn . liǎnggè rén dōu rěn zhe xiào , méiyǒu zhēn qù gào .
pairs.english: He looked up; Pavo was indeed pouring, the kettle’s label deliberately facing outward this time. Both stifled their laughter without reporting him.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头，帕沃果然在倒，壶上的纸这回还特意转到外面。两个人都忍着笑，没有真去告。

pairs.target: zhè táng kè méiyǒu ràng xuéshēng dòngshǒuzuò jiāohuàn . bǎi lǎoshī shōuqǐ tóngtiáo , zhī liúxià liǎngtào pǔtōng shuǐcáo , jiào tāmen xiān liàn bǎ qǐchū wēndù , shíjiān hé dúshù fēnkāi , xià yìtáng zài lái chá .
pairs.english: Students made no exchange in this class. Instructor Bai put away the copper rods, leaving two ordinary water-bath sets for practising initial temperature, time and readings separately, to be checked next lesson.
pairs.hanzi: 这堂课没有让学生动手做交换。柏老师收起铜条，只留下两套普通水槽，叫他们先练把起初温度、时间和读数分开，下一堂再来查。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn mō tiě shíhuì de nà yìdiǎn gǎnjué , kěbukěyǐ zhíjiē nálái zhǎo zhèlǐ de biànhuà . tā shuō bùnéng tì tā xiān dá , yào xué xīn de fēnbiàn bànfǎ , shǒu yě búshì nǎlǐ rè jiù wǎng nǎlǐ tiē . jīntiān huíqù , kěyǐ xiǎng , bùnéngzìjǐ ná guō lái shì .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if his iron-working sense could directly find this change. She would not answer for him in advance; he must learn a new way to distinguish it, and not put his hands wherever it was hot. He could think at home today, but not experiment alone with pots.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问摸铁时会的那一点感觉，可不可以直接拿来找这里的变化。她说不能替他先答，要学新的分辨办法，手也不是哪里热就往哪里贴。今天回去，可以想，不能自己拿锅来试。

pairs.target: pà wò lìjí jǔqǐ bēizi , shuō guō méiyǒu , bēi xíngbùxíng . bǎi lǎoshī kàn tā yìyǎn , jiāng hēchá nà zhī hú līn zǒu le . děng tā chūmén , tèlún cái dīshēng shuō , zhège shōuhuí dǎo shì lìkè jiànxiào .
pairs.english: Pavo raised his cup at once: no pot, but would a cup do? Instructor Bai looked at him and took away the tea kettle. Only after she left did Teren murmur that this cancellation worked immediately.
pairs.hanzi:
帕沃立即举起杯子，说锅没有，杯行不行。
柏老师看他一眼，将喝茶那只壶拎走了。等她出门，特伦才低声说，这个收回倒是立刻见效。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé zài zhǐ shàng huàchū yìtiáo wāi xiàn . tā méiyǒu cādiào , pángbiān xiě shàng dìyītáng , zhǔnbèi yǐhòu fān huílái kànkàn , zìjǐ dàodǐ shìcóng nǎlǐ kāishǐ fēnbùqīng de .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and drew a crooked line by accident. He left it, wrote ‘first lesson’ beside it, and planned to look back later at where his confusion began.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得在纸上划出一条歪线。他没有擦掉，旁边写上第一堂，准备以后翻回来看看，自己到底是从哪里开始分不清的。
